verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online's own marketing docs cover every element of the story. You can create branded invoices, add an online pay button, see exactly when an invoice is viewed, and get notified when it is paid, with automatic recording and matching of payments. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party help documentation (the evidence is marketing copy only) and independent or hands-on corroboration of view/paid tracking and online payment behavior.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create and send invoices with online payment options and see when they are viewed and paid

citations.quote: Send your invoice, know exactly when it’s viewed, and get notified when it’s paid.
Enable online payments to add a button to invoices for your customers to pay instantly online.
add your logo and colors and create tailored professional invoices within minutes.
When customers pay through QuickBooks invoices, we’ll record and match it for you.
